versions.content: Variable existence of container on value side Type: valid Description: The existence of a container and its substructure shall be variable in the ECU Configuration Parameter Description. Rationale: Containers hold most of the structure of the configuration description. By enabling variability on container many use-cases can be supported. Use Case: Variable existence of an OSTask. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
